character: Purpose-built high resort (2,035 m) at the heart of the Via Lattea (Milky Way), a large cross-border ski area in Piedmont linking Sestriere, Sauze d'Oulx, Sansicario, Cesana, Claviere and Pragelato with Montgenèvre in France. Sestriere hosted alpine events at the 2006 Turin Winter Olympics (reference).
